recommendations.action: Put AI Search first: it produced the only new B2B order and 3 of 4 website orders. Ship one answer page per missing buyer question each week.
Email quality over volume: 50 personalised emails a day instead of 100 generic ones, and a daily call list for Sristi from every reply.
Connect a reader for Google Business insights and reviews; without it 2 agents work blind.
Conversion before content: about 1,200 visits gave 4 orders. Add real reviews, COD and free-shipping trust lines on top products; pause new blogs for 2 weeks.
Fix cane planters and sabai cannibalisation (found 3 runs in a row) and send the 7 drafted backlink pitches; inbound links are still 0.
Answer every Facebook Live price ask; ask Sristi for one Live a week; Instagram moves to reels; Pinterest judged by clicks to site.
The weekly limit ran out on 28 Oct. Skip agent runs with nothing new, keep reports to 5 lines, and stop duplicate runs (use outreach/RUN_LOCK.json every time).

takeaway: AI search is the agent team's best earner (1 B2B order, 3 of 4 web orders); Google rankings are flat and social brings views but few visits. Shift effort from email volume and blogs to AI answers, conversion and replies.
